scope: Second exploratory round: nested group CV of probability correction after first-round diagnostics. Neither round is independent full-pipeline OOF or Kaggle test accuracy; base CNNs were selected on these validation images.
test_policy: No test target labels or quotas. Only frozen class probabilities are model inputs.
selection_policy: Same inner selection and outer promotion gate as round one. This round was motivated by NLL improvements without accuracy gains: uncertainty weighting, bounded smooth classification loss, and disagreement selection target different mechanisms. All failures remain reported.
